urls.title: Websites or sitemaps
urls.description: Website URLs (sitemaps are found via robots.txt and common paths) or direct sitemap URLs (.xml, .xml.gz, .txt).

includePatterns.title: Include URLs matching
includePatterns.description: Keep only URLs containing any of these text fragments or regular expressions (e.g. /blog/, /products/).

modifiedAfter.title: Only URLs modified after
modifiedAfter.description: Uses each URL's <lastmod> where the site provides it.
